duration.text: The Summer Intensive Chinese Program at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 333 USD/In total ￥ 2400 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Photocopy of valid visa or residence permit

requirements.text: 18-65 years old, mentally and phsically healthy 2. Students who obey china laws and regulations
